summary: First iteration testing of Polish dental recall MVP. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (dashboard, patients CRUD, remind SMS/EMAIL with consent check, exclude/include, CSV import preview+commit with validation, procedures CRUD, templates & settings persistence, reminders list, recall/run, ROI, public booking confirm+reject, 404 handling). Frontend: dashboard tiles render and navigate with query param, patient search works, all sidebar navigation routes reachable (import/recall/templates/messages/roi/settings), ROI page shows revenue, public booking flow /zapis/{id} works end-to-end: start -> pick day -> pick time -> confirm -> success screen with 'Dodaj do kalendarza' (add-calendar-btn) button visible. Note: dashboard intentionally renders 4 tiles (excludes AKTYWNY count tile) - it is shown on the sidebar/list level instead; not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 739 lines - consider splitting into modules (routes/, models/, services/) as it grows beyond MVP.
run_recall_scan uses interwal_miesiace * 30 for due-date arithmetic (approximation); acceptable for MVP but consider dateutil.relativedelta for calendar accuracy.
generate_slots uses random.sample per request; slots change on every GET (documented as mocked, but frontend re-fetches may show different times if page reloads).
PUT /templates and /settings accept a raw dict (no Pydantic schema) - fine for MVP but consider validation.
ROI conversion computed from all reminders count vs recent appts could double-count if same patient reminded multiple times; acceptable for MVP demo.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on auto-seeded demo data (32 patients).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers all API endpoints. Public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. For booking tests, fetch a patient id via GET /api/patients?status=DO_PRZYPOMNIENIA. Reset demo state via POST /api/admin/reset-demo if test data pollutes counts.
